LAREDO, Texas — Two people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on alleged federal violations, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search.

DIEGO ARMANDO MONRREAL-CONTRERAS — Monrreal-Contreras was arrested at 12:34 p.m. on an alleged federal violation. He is held by Homeland Security under United States Marshals custody. Bond was not set. The booking record did not list a city of residence.

RICARDO GARCIA — Garcia was arrested at 12:36 p.m. on an alleged federal violation. He is held by the United States Secret Service under Bureau of Prisons custody. Bond was not set. The booking record listed the city as Laredo, TX 78046.

All charges are allegations. Each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
